# Watchlist brief: 2026-10-12

*Sample data for the test environment: prices and news are simulated.*

## Market backdrop

The S&P 500 fell 3.09% (z-score -3.2). Strongest sector: Health Care (XLV) -2.18%; weakest: Materials (XLB) -4.20%. Unusual sector moves: Consumer Staples -2.33% (z-score -2.2), Industrials -2.39% (z-score -2.0), Consumer Discretionary -2.80% (z-score -2.7), Real Estate -2.84% (z-score -2.5), Energy -2.87% (z-score -2.7), Technology -3.40% (z-score -2.6), Financials -3.56% (z-score -3.1), Utilities -3.64% (z-score -3.2), Communication Services -4.06% (z-score -3.4), Materials -4.20% (z-score -3.3).

## Notable moves

### AMZN: -2.22% (z-score -0.97, volume 2.11x normal)
- **What happened:** AMZN moved -2.22% on volume 2.11x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** AMZN fell 2.22%; its sector (Consumer Discretionary, XLY) fell 2.80% and the S&P 500 fell 3.09%. AMZN moved in line with its sector and the market, and the market's own move was unusual (z-score -3.2), so this looks like a market-wide move.
- **Likely why:** A broad market sell-off after economic data. [Sample Wire](https://news.example.com/2026-10-12/amzn-macro)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

### JPM: -5.33% (z-score -3.24, volume 1.41x normal)
- **What happened:** JPM moved -5.33% on volume 1.41x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** JPM fell 5.33%; its sector (Financials, XLF) fell 3.56% and the S&P 500 fell 3.09%. JPM moved in line with its sector and the market, and the market's own move was unusual (z-score -3.2), so this looks like a market-wide move.
- **Likely why:** A broad market sell-off after economic data. [Example Financial News](https://news.example.com/2026-10-12/jpm-macro)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

## Quiet

AAPL (-2.27%), MSFT (-3.54%), NVDA (+3.50%)

## Coming up

- Tue Oct 13: Microsoft (MSFT): Court hearing in patent case
- Fri Oct 16: NVIDIA (NVDA): Product launch event
- Mon Oct 19: Microsoft (MSFT): Earnings report
